notes: 25 candidates: 1 program-list, 0 single-record, 24 not-a-list. The one list page is Boston University Questrom's Operations & Technology Management 'Placement of Doctoral Graduates' (capture 2015-08-30): 22 named PhD graduates from Sep-85 to May-00 with dissertation titles, degree month/year and a 'Currently at' employer and title; the page is undated and the 'currently' positions reflect roughly 2000-era information (Tsikriktsis listed as London Business School assistant professor), so treat positions as later-career snapshots, not verified first jobs. The 23 Caltech Alumni Association pages are all single-person class notes, a Distinguished Alumni profile, and In Memoriam stubs for science, engineering and mathematics PhD alumni (physics, chemistry, geology, astronomy, aeronautics, biology); the class notes do state degree year and a current job, but none belongs to an operations or management program (Caltech has no business school), so they are marked not-a-list rather than single-record; the five In Memoriam pages carry no text beyond name and degree years. The ASU W. P. Carey alumni page is an alumni-relations landing page with no names. No institution-by-host corrections needed.
